explanation: The fee applies to every channel the agency runs: paid social 240 × 1.15 = 276 euros and display 160 × 1.15 = 184 euros. Paid search has no fee: 300 euros. Total = 300 + 276 + 184 = 760 euros. Adding the fee to paid social only gives 736 euros and makes social look dearer than display for the same media.
